findings.detail: jamovi imported tick`name as tick_name; exact schema review FP-03/1 failed. Used pilot x/y values match typed fixtures exactly.

After owned Cmd+W close, bridge reported noWindowsAvailable; optional launch_app API absent. Finder binding timed out with expired node_repl continuation. No reopen success was inferred. Human reopened FP-03, new GUI instance was verified and native post-reopen edit passed. Do not retry Finder fallback. Later native getApp/Open Recent succeeded after explicit user request; optional launch_app absence does not mean getApp cannot relaunch.
Temporary checkbox helper initially counted the focused-element footer as a second match after a successful native click; corrected to match numbered checkbox rows only. No production code changed.

Scrolled Model Comparison AX clicks did not expand the intended section. Screenshot captures exposed the miss; a coordinate click on the observed header was followed by native checkbox/list verification. This is assisted targeting, not unattended-driver acceptance.

findings.details: Step2 deliberately restores retained ordinary comparisonGroup; step3 requires clearing that hidden preference, although native comparison panels retain it. Actual warning/plots/estimates/statistics correct. No backend mutation or manifest change used to manufacture success.

Empty model clears plotX and plotGroup to NULL through native synchronization. Waiting diagnostic and stale-output clearing are correct; manifest step3 expects z/group retained. Step4, final reopen and post-reopen edit pass original numerical reference.

Invalid main cluster-specific binary-panel layout has saved plot ANALYSIS_ERROR, expected message and no image resource. Actual host shows blank image area, no visible diagnostic in AX or inspected image region. Fixed estimates/SE/CI remain current and match independent REML references. Distinguish module versus jamovi renderer responsibility in correction stage; no fitting defect or fix claimed.

Native comparisonPlotNote visibly reports the comparison image rendering error, while comparisonplot stores the error and clears the resource. Verifier requires rendering_error diagnostic scope itself to be an image with an error; actual companion HTML note cannot satisfy that contract. Raw verifier fails; native isolation observation and independent both-fit/ML statistics pass. No false image-scope observation or harness change introduced.

Native getApp relaunched jamovi and Open Recent reliably reopened the named owned document after user requested autonomous opening. Bridge reports identity but not monitor coordinates; later placement cannot be independently reconfirmed. Thirteen observations explicitly use secondary_monitor=null, blocking eight otherwise passing checks. Existing failures retain failed status plus unobserved ownership/placement gate. Functional evidence remains separately retained.
